items.item_text: Bachelors Other Business administration, health administration or related field
Progressive sales experience within the context of physician relationships -pharmaceuticals, devices, etc.
Works with Provider Relations team to ensure consistent and meaningful sales calls on targeted physicians, rural physicians, and those who have split patient volume practices.
Develops and maintains direct marketing relationships with hospital's medical staff and regional physicians with a focus on long term relationship building, communication, and customer service.
Understands physician needs within the market and works to develop and increase usage of Dignity Health services by physicians who are split admitters.
Responsible for developing and retaining referrals from market physicians as well as increasing growth through sales and marketing.
Support Dignity Health's reputation and branding through education and awareness of the Hospital's services.
Quickly responds to changes in the marketplace and adapts to the evolving needs of the organization.
Special skills required include: excellent interpersonal, human relations, and negotiation skills;
Excellent written and oral communication skills, including report writing skills required;
Ability to work independently and throughout the system to solve problems; strong service orientation with sensitivity to physician needs;
Ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with physicians and all levels of staff;
Computer skills including Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
